text:
Trend-change buy gate: when enabled, a long signal that occurred during a down-regime can be deferred until an up-regime breakout bar, reducing buys straight into active sell regimes.

Trend-change sell gate: when enabled, exit signals that occurred during an up-regime can be deferred until a down-regime breakdown bar, helping avoid selling the first green bar of a fresh rally leg.

Static price filter — buy ceiling: optional cap that blocks new buys if price is above a user-set level (useful when defending overhead supply).

Static price filter — sell floor: optional floor that blocks sells until price clears a user-set level (useful when avoiding exits into illiquid dips).

Date/time window: backtest and live behavior respect user start/end timestamps; outside the window signals do not arm.
